WCAG_method.RGB_space: 8bit sRGB, actual raw PNG RGBA and actual opaque DSL foreground

WCAG_method.scope: Apply normal-text4.5 threshold to everyText, even large/bold title; no large-text3.0 exception. Antialias edge pixels are excluded from foreground-source contrast assessment.

gradient_equivalence_lattice.proof: gradient projection q=W*x+H*y; W*(x+H/g*k)+H*(y-W/g*k)=q. Pixel-center .5 offsets cancel identically. All references chosen at valid extreme integer k, within max(step) pixels of an empty outer boundary; no interpolation/guessed endpoint colors.
gradient_equivalence_lattice.composited_foreground_layer_policy: Source full-canvas opaque background then four graphics; every graphic AABB disjoint from all text boxes, no alpha/filter/shadow. Therefore text background is the actual gradient; text source is opaque and core RGB is actually detected.
